# Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be decent. Assume the other person is acting in good faith. Argue about code, not
about people.

## What is expected

- Treat disagreement as normal and settle it with evidence — a test, a measurement,
  a screenshot.
- Accept that maintainers may decline a change that is correct but out of scope.
- Write review comments you would be glad to receive.

## What is not acceptable

Harassment, personal attacks, discrimination on any grounds, sexualised language or
imagery, publishing someone's private information, or sustained disruption of
discussion. This applies in issues, pull requests, commit messages, and any other
project space.

## Reporting

Report a problem privately to the maintainer through the contact on
[github.com/Ajarallah](https://github.com/Ajarallah). Reports are handled in
confidence. The maintainer may edit or remove contributions, and may block accounts,
in response to behaviour that breaks this document.

This is a small project maintained by one person; expect a considered reply rather
than an immediate one.
